incidents.name: MARS reflections accrue to its own pair
incidents.notes: MARS distributes transfer-tax reflections to the MARS/WBNB pair itself, so the attacker used a PancakeV3 flash loan to repeatedly swap and sync the pair and monetise the reflected balance.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x436D3629888B50127EC4947D54Bb0aB1120962A0 created 2024-04-15T03:20:14Z by 0xb61caff7e185eb0815a6c738a999ab47a2fe7c52, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x306174b707ebf6d7301a0bcd898ae1666ec176ae; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
